hypothesis_text: Simultaneous inhibition of RAD51 at both the protein level (via ivabradine-activated ATF6→FBXO24 axis, PMID 40764992) and the mRNA level (via Jab1/CSN5 inhibitor-mediated HRR transcript destabilization, PMID 40819058) will produce additive-to-synergistic BRCAness induction in wild-type BRCA1/2 TNBC, enabling PARPi sensitivity at lower doses.

cell_lines.name: MDA-MB-231
cell_lines.rationale: Primary experimental line; represents the wild-type BRCA1/2 TNBC population targeted by hyp-tnbc-002. HCN channel expression confirmed (target of ivabradine). Widely used in HR reporter (DR-GFP) transfection protocols.

cell_lines.name: HCC1937-BRCA1-restored
cell_lines.rationale: Isogenic control: HCC1937 carries germline BRCA1 5382insC. The BRCA1-restored derivative re-establishes functional HR. By comparing HCC1937-parental (high BRCAness baseline) with HCC1937-restored (low BRCAness baseline), we can calibrate the BRCAness induction magnitude produced by the drug combination in the MDA-MB-231 background.
cell_lines.note_on_parental: HCC1937 parental (BRCA1 null) serves as a technical BRCAness-positive reference; include as an unlabeled reference lane in Western blots and RAD51 foci assays.
cell_lines.source: Commercially available via ATCC; BRCA1-restored derivative described in PMID 12525554

drug_matrix.note: 27 conditions × 2 cell lines × 3 biological replicates = 162 data points per readout assay

drugs.name: ivabradine
drugs.mechanism: HCN channel blocker; activates ER stress → ATF6 transcription factor → FBXO24 E3 ubiquitin ligase upregulation → RAD51 proteasomal degradation (protein-level depletion)

dose_rationale.10: sub-toxic dose showing partial RAD51 depletion in PMID 40764992 (IC20 range for MDA-MB-231)
dose_rationale.50: dose demonstrating maximal RAD51 depletion and DR-GFP reduction per PMID 40764992; confirmed non-lethal at 72h in that study

drugs.solvent: DMSO (stock 10 mM in DMSO; dilute in medium to ≤0.1% DMSO final)

drugs.name: CSN5i-3
drugs.mechanism: Small-molecule Jab1/CSN5 inhibitor; Jab1/CSN5 stabilizes HRR mRNA transcripts (RAD51, BRCA1, PALB2); inhibition destabilizes HRR transcripts → RAD51 mRNA-level depletion

dose_rationale.5: dose near IC20 for CSN5 inhibition per PMID 40819058; partial mRNA destabilization expected
dose_rationale.20: dose producing maximal HRR transcript reduction per PMID 40819058 without significant standalone toxicity at 72h

drugs.name: olaparib
drugs.mechanism: PARP1/2 inhibitor; synthetic lethal with HRD/BRCAness; used as the challenge agent to test whether RAD51 dual-depletion produces functional BRCAness sufficient for PARPi sensitivity

dose_rationale.1: below IC50 for HR-proficient TNBC (~5-8 µM); will reveal sensitization only if BRCAness is induced
dose_rationale.10: near IC50 for BRCA1-null TNBC; allows separation of partial vs full BRCAness induction

treatment_schedule.t0: Seed cells at 3,000–5,000 cells/well (96-well for viability; 8-well chamber slide for IF; 6-well for DR-GFP and Western)
treatment_schedule.t_24h: Add all three drugs simultaneously (single addition protocol); collect separate Western blot plate wells at 24h for RAD51 depletion confirmation
treatment_schedule.t_72h: Fix/lyse cells for primary readouts (RAD51 foci IF, DR-GFP flow cytometry, CellTiter-Glo viability)
treatment_schedule.note: Single-addition protocol chosen over sequential because PMID 40764992 used simultaneous addition for SynergyFinder analysis; sequential pre-sensitization protocol is a secondary experiment for future cycle

readouts.name: RAD51 nuclear foci (immunofluorescence)
readouts.purpose: Direct functional readout of HR capacity. Cells are irradiated (2 Gy, 1h before fixation) to induce DSBs and score RAD51 recruitment. BRCAness = failure to form RAD51 foci (≤10 foci/nucleus threshold, per Castroviejo-Bermejo et al. protocol).
readouts.format: 8-well chamber slides (Ibidi µ-slide); 3 biological replicates per condition
readouts.counterstain: DAPI (nuclei) + γH2AX (rabbit AF647, 1:500 — confirms DSB induction)
readouts.scoring: Automated: Operetta CLS or CellProfiler pipeline; ≥50 nuclei per condition; foci counted per nucleus; report % cells with ≤10 RAD51 foci post-IR as BRCAness score

readouts.name: DR-GFP homologous recombination reporter assay
readouts.purpose: Quantitative HR efficiency. DR-GFP integrates two truncated GFP copies flanking an I-SceI cut site; HR repair restores GFP. HR efficiency = % GFP+ cells by flow cytometry. Dual RAD51 depletion should reduce GFP+ frequency compared to single agents.
readouts.format: 6-well plates; cells stably transfected with DR-GFP reporter (lentiviral or plasmid; I-SceI delivered by transient transfection 48h before endpoint)
readouts.protocol_reference: Pierce et al. 1999 Genes Dev; adapted for TNBC in PMID 40764992 (ivabradine-olaparib arm)
readouts.flow_cytometer: BD FACSCanto II or equivalent; 10,000 events per sample; FL1 channel (GFP)
readouts.analysis: HR efficiency = (% GFP+ in treated) / (% GFP+ in DMSO vehicle); normalize to cell viability to correct for proliferation differences
readouts.note_on_transfection: MDA-MB-231 DR-GFP stable line should be generated 2 weeks prior to experiment; confirm GFP+ baseline with I-SceI transfection before drug matrix begins

readouts.name: Cell viability (CellTiter-Glo 2.0 luminescence)
readouts.purpose: Primary pharmacological endpoint for synergy analysis. Viability (% of DMSO control) fed into SynergyFinder 3.0 to compute ZIP synergy scores for all 27-condition matrix.
readouts.format: 96-well white-walled plates; 3 biological replicates per condition; 3 technical replicates averaged before SynergyFinder input
readouts.reagent: CellTiter-Glo 2.0 (Promega G9241); follow manufacturer protocol (equal volume reagent, 10 min lysis, plate reader luminescence)
readouts.normalization: Normalize to DMSO vehicle (0,0,0) condition per cell line; report as fraction surviving

readouts.name: Western blot — RAD51 protein depletion confirmation
readouts.purpose: Mechanistic confirmation that ivabradine→FBXO24 axis and CSN5i-3→mRNA destabilization both reduce RAD51 protein at 24h, prior to full 72h endpoint. Validates that both arms of the dual-depletion mechanism are active.
readouts.format: 6-well plates; collect 4 key conditions only: DMSO, ivabradine 50µM alone, CSN5i-3 20µM alone, ivabradine 50µM + CSN5i-3 20µM (all at olaparib=0 to isolate RAD51 depletion effect)

targets.expected: decrease in ivabradine and CSN5i-3 arms; additive decrease in combo
increase in ivabradine arm per PMID 40764992 ATF6 activation

targets.note: run RT-qPCR on same 24h lysate RNA fraction; primers: RAD51 exon 3-4 junction; normalizer: GAPDH + ACTB
targets.expected: decrease in CSN5i-3 arm; minimal effect in ivabradine arm (protein-only mechanism)

readouts.key_question: Is RAD51 depletion in the combo arm greater than either single agent? If Western shows additivity at protein level, this mechanistically supports the hypothesis. If only one arm depletes RAD51, re-evaluate CSN5i-3 dose.

week_minus_2.label: Cell line prep
tasks: Generate MDA-MB-231 DR-GFP stable line (lentiviral transduction, puromycin selection)
Confirm HCC1937-BRCA1-restored identity by Sanger sequencing of BRCA1 locus
Validate CSN5i-3 stock purity by HPLC (if new lot)
Order all antibodies; confirm lot numbers
Set up CellProfiler RAD51 foci scoring pipeline on positive control slides

week_minus_1.label: Pilot dose-response
tasks: Single-agent dose-response (ivabradine 0–100µM, CSN5i-3 0–50µM, olaparib 0–50µM) in MDA-MB-231 for 72h viability only
Confirm IC20/IC50 values consistent with doses chosen for matrix
Confirm DMSO vehicle tolerance ≤0.1% for all combined drug conditions

day_0.label: Plate seeding
tasks: Seed MDA-MB-231 and HCC1937-BRCA1-restored into all assay formats simultaneously
96-well (viability), 8-well chamber slide (RAD51 IF), 6-well (Western + DR-GFP)
Density: 3,000 cells/well (96-well), 15,000 cells/well (8-well), 100,000 cells/well (6-well)

day_1.label: Drug addition (T=24h after seeding)
tasks: Add all three drugs simultaneously to all wells per matrix
Maintain DMSO ≤0.1% total across all drug combinations
Collect Western blot 6-well plates at end of day (24h post-addition)

day_3.label: Endpoint collection (T=72h post drug addition)
tasks: Irradiate 8-well slides (2 Gy, Cs-137 irradiator), wait 1h, then fix for RAD51 IF
Transfect DR-GFP 6-well cells with I-SceI at T=48h; collect at T=72h by flow cytometry
CellTiter-Glo on 96-well viability plates
Fix 8-well slides with 4% PFA, proceed to immunofluorescence staining

day_4_to_7.label: Staining, imaging, data collection
tasks: Complete RAD51 IF staining protocol (2-day antibody incubation recommended)
Acquire images on Operetta CLS; run CellProfiler foci-scoring pipeline
Flow cytometry for DR-GFP
Western blot development and quantification (ImageJ densitometry)

day_8_to_10.label: Data analysis
tasks: Enter viability data into SynergyFinder 3.0 (web tool; ZIP model; 3D synergy landscape output)
Calculate ZIP synergy scores for all drug pair combinations within the 3-drug matrix
Statistical analysis: two-way ANOVA + Tukey post-hoc for RAD51 foci and DR-GFP
Compile go/no-go decision vs criteria below

timeline.critical_path: MDA-MB-231 DR-GFP stable line generation (week -2) is the rate-limiting step

primary_analysis_viability.method: SynergyFinder 3.0 ZIP (Zero Interaction Potency) synergy model
primary_analysis_viability.input: Fraction surviving (0-1 scale) for each of 27 conditions, averaged across 3 replicates
primary_analysis_viability.output: ZIP delta score per drug pair combination; positive values indicate synergy, negative antagonism
primary_analysis_viability.threshold_synergistic: ZIP delta > 10 (established threshold in SynergyFinder literature)

secondary_analysis_rad51_foci.method: Two-way ANOVA (ivabradine dose × CSN5i-3 dose) per cell line; Tukey HSD post-hoc
secondary_analysis_rad51_foci.dependent_variable: % cells with ≤10 RAD51 foci post-2Gy IR (BRCAness score)
secondary_analysis_rad51_foci.interaction_term: ivabradine × CSN5i-3 interaction p-value is the key test of dual-layer additivity

secondary_analysis_dr_gfp.method: Same two-way ANOVA structure; dependent variable = HR efficiency (% GFP+ normalized)
secondary_analysis_dr_gfp.expected_direction: decrease in HR efficiency with increasing ivabradine and CSN5i-3 doses

power_calculation.effect_size_assumption: Cohen's d = 1.0 (large effect; justified by PMID 40764992 showing ~40% additional viability reduction with olaparib combo vs olaparib alone in ivabradine-treated cells)
power_calculation.calculated_power: ~0.68 at n=3 for d=1.0 (one-way comparison); acceptable given large expected effect size and confirmatory nature of multiple orthogonal readouts (R1+R2+R3 convergent evidence)
power_calculation.note: n=3 is standard for in vitro pilot experiments. If effect sizes are smaller than expected (d<0.8), n will need to increase to 6 for a follow-up confirmatory experiment. The combination of three independent readouts (viability, RAD51 foci, DR-GFP) substantially increases overall study confidence even with n=3 per condition.
power_calculation.upgrade_criterion: If pilot data shows d<0.8 for primary viability endpoint, pre-register confirmatory experiment with n=6 and power ≥0.80

multiple_comparisons.strategy: Bonferroni correction applied within each assay family; FDR (Benjamini-Hochberg) across all 27-condition pairwise tests

estimated_cost.note: Estimates based on 2025 US academic lab pricing

items.item: Western blot reagents (PVDF, NuPAGE gels, buffers)

estimated_cost.note_on_scope: This estimate covers one full experimental cycle (all 27 conditions × 2 cell lines × 3 replicates). Does not include stable cell line generation labor (week -2 prep) which is ~20h additional bench time but no major reagent cost if lentiviral prep is done in-house.

evidence_support.title: Ivabradine activates ATF6→FBXO24→RAD51 proteasomal degradation axis inducing BRCAness in non-germline BRCA-mutated TNBC
evidence_support.relevance: Establishes the protein-level RAD51 depletion arm of the dual hypothesis. Demonstrates olaparib synergy (SynergyFinder 3.0 confirmed) and DR-GFP HR reduction in MDA-MB-231. Provides dose precedent: 50 µM ivabradine used in that study, establishing our high-dose anchor.

evidence_support.title: Jab1/CSN5 stabilizes HRR mRNA transcripts; CSN5 inhibition resensitizes TNBC to olaparib in vivo
evidence_support.relevance: Establishes the mRNA-level RAD51 depletion arm. Validates CSN5i-3 as the tool compound. Demonstrates olaparib resensitization in vivo, supporting translation of in vitro findings. Note: in vitro dose-response data from this paper informs CSN5i-3 dose selection.

evidence_support.title: HRD prevalence in TNBC 50-70%; RAD51 foci functional assay achieves >90% sensitivity for HRD detection
evidence_support.relevance: Validates RAD51 foci assay as the gold-standard functional BRCAness readout used in R1. Confirms that RAD51 foci scoring (≤10 foci/nucleus post-IR) is the appropriate BRCAness threshold.

evidence_support.title: HCC1937 BRCA1-restored isogenic pair characterization
evidence_support.relevance: Establishes the isogenic cell line pair used in this design. BRCA1-restored derivative is the established HR-proficient control for this parental line.

evidence_support.source: pubmed_search: ivabradine TNBC olaparib combination SynergyFinder RAD51 foci
evidence_support.result: PMID 40764992 is the primary hit; no additional independent replications found as of 2026-03-30. This means our experiment would be the first independent validation of the ivabradine→RAD51 axis — high impact if confirmed.
evidence_support.implication: Novelty confirmed: no prior study combines both ivabradine and CSN5i-3 in a dual-layer depletion design

evidence_support.source: pubmed_search: CSN5i-3 Jab1 inhibitor TNBC cell line
evidence_support.result: PMID 40819058 is the primary source for CSN5i-3 in TNBC. No published dose-response for CSN5i-3 in MDA-MB-231 specifically — pilot dose-response in week -1 is therefore essential before committing to matrix doses.
evidence_support.implication: Week -1 pilot required; doses chosen are informed extrapolations from PMID 40819058 but require empirical validation in MDA-MB-231

evidence_support.source: pubmed_search: DR-GFP HR reporter assay triple negative breast cancer
evidence_support.result: DR-GFP assay is well-established in TNBC models. PMID 40764992 used it for ivabradine arm. Pierce et al. (1999) original protocol widely reproduced. MDA-MB-231 is a standard host for DR-GFP transfection. No issues anticipated with assay feasibility.
evidence_support.implication: R2 (DR-GFP) is technically feasible and directly comparable to ivabradine paper; allows cross-study comparison

synergy_analysis_plan.rationale: ZIP was used in PMID 40764992 for the ivabradine+olaparib analysis, enabling direct cross-study comparison. ZIP accounts for dose-response independence assumptions more robustly than HSA or Bliss for the 3-drug case.
synergy_analysis_plan.input_format: 3D drug matrix: rows = ivabradine dose, columns = CSN5i-3 dose, layers = olaparib dose; values = fraction surviving (0-1)
key_comparisons: ivabradine × olaparib (CSN5i-3=0): replication of PMID 40764992 synergy finding — internal validation
CSN5i-3 × olaparib (ivabradine=0): novel synergy test from PMID 40819058 in vitro arm
ivabradine × CSN5i-3 × olaparib: full 3-drug synergy landscape — the central test of hyp-tnbc-002
synergy_analysis_plan.expected_outcome: Positive ZIP delta (>10) for the triple combination at olaparib 1µM conditions, indicating that dual RAD51 depletion enables PARPi sensitivity below the threshold effective for either single agent alone

positive_controls: HCC1937 parental (BRCA1 null) — high BRCAness baseline; should show ≤10 RAD51 foci/nucleus and low HR efficiency with no drug treatment
MDA-MB-231 + olaparib 10µM + ivabradine 50µM — expected synergy per PMID 40764992; if not observed, technical problem with assay
negative_controls: MDA-MB-231 DMSO vehicle (0,0,0) — baseline HR-proficient; should show >10 RAD51 foci/nucleus post-IR and >70% GFP+ (HR efficient)
technical_controls: No-I-SceI transfection control for DR-GFP assay (GFP+ should be background, ~0.1%)
No-IR control for RAD51 foci (confirm low baseline foci without DSB induction)
DMSO-matched vehicle at maximum DMSO concentration used in any drug combination

scenario_A_synergy_confirmed.criteria: ZIP delta >10 for triple combo; RAD51 foci BRCAness score >50% in triple combo vs <20% in DMSO; DR-GFP HR efficiency <30% of DMSO baseline
scenario_A_synergy_confirmed.interpretation: hyp-tnbc-002 SUPPORTED. Both layers of RAD51 depletion are active and produce additive-to-synergistic BRCAness. Proceed to: (1) in vivo PDX validation, (2) patient-derived organoid testing, (3) clinical trial design for ivabradine+CSN5i-3+olaparib triplet in wt-BRCA1/2 TNBC
scenario_A_synergy_confirmed.next_step_hypothesis: hyp-tnbc-004: dose de-escalation — can olaparib 0.1µM achieve synthetic lethality with dual depletion? (reduces toxicity)

scenario_B_additive_not_synergistic.criteria: ZIP delta 0–10; BRCAness score intermediate; viability reduction additive
scenario_B_additive_not_synergistic.interpretation: hyp-tnbc-002 PARTIALLY SUPPORTED. Dual depletion adds value over single agents but synergy threshold not met. Investigate: is CSN5i-3 depleting RAD51 at mRNA level (confirm by RT-qPCR R4)? If mRNA depletion confirmed but no additional protein effect, the two mechanisms may converge on the same rate-limiting pool. Consider testing BRCAness at earlier timepoints (24h vs 72h).
scenario_B_additive_not_synergistic.next_step: Reflexion cycle: re-query literature for sequential dosing schedule — pre-treat with CSN5i-3 24h before ivabradine addition

scenario_C_no_effect_CSN5i3.criteria: CSN5i-3 single agent shows <10% change in RAD51 protein by Western; DR-GFP unchanged
scenario_C_no_effect_CSN5i3.interpretation: CSN5i-3 dose insufficient OR MDA-MB-231 has low baseline Jab1/CSN5 expression. Action: (1) confirm Jab1/CSN5 protein expression in MDA-MB-231 by Western; (2) if expressed, escalate CSN5i-3 dose; (3) if not expressed, switch to HCC38 or BT-549 TNBC lines with confirmed Jab1 overexpression per PMID 40819058
scenario_C_no_effect_CSN5i3.go_nogo_impact: NO-GO for this cell line; re-run with alternative TNBC line

scenario_D_unexpected_antagonism.criteria: ZIP delta <0 for triple combination despite additive pairwise combinations
scenario_D_unexpected_antagonism.interpretation: Unexpected drug-drug antagonism. Investigate: (1) does olaparib activate ATM/ATR signaling that upregulates RAD51 transcription, partially rescuing depletion? (2) does ER stress from ivabradine trigger a survival pathway that cross-talks with Jab1 axis? (3) pharmacokinetic interference at cellular uptake level?
scenario_D_unexpected_antagonism.next_step: Sequentially add drugs rather than simultaneously; test ivabradine+CSN5i-3 24h pre-treatment then olaparib addition

go_nogo_criteria: GO criteria (all three required): (1) ZIP synergy delta ≥ +5 for triple combination (ivabradine 50µM + CSN5i-3 20µM + olaparib 1µM) in MDA-MB-231, (2) RAD51 foci BRCAness score ≥ 40% of cells with ≤10 foci in triple combination condition vs ≤15% in DMSO vehicle, (3) DR-GFP HR efficiency ≤ 40% of DMSO baseline in triple combination arm. NO-GO if: any single criterion fails AND cannot be explained by a technically resolvable confound within one reflexion cycle. CONDITIONAL GO if: criteria met in MDA-MB-231 but not HCC1937-restored (expected — confirms wt-BRCA selectivity of the effect).

dome_metadata.novelty_claim: No prior published protocol combines ivabradine (ATF6→FBXO24→RAD51 protein depletion) with CSN5i-3 (Jab1→HRR mRNA destabilization) in a dual-layer RAD51 depletion design. This experiment would be the first test of whether two mechanistically orthogonal RAD51 depletion routes produce greater-than-additive BRCAness induction, potentially enabling PARPi use at clinically safer doses in wt-BRCA1/2 TNBC.
